scope: Bounded offline second-stage transport investigation only; no application execution/attach, profile/cache/audio read, server configuration change or broad Ghidra analysis. Independent REA stdio open/close validation plus explicit PE and bounded Capstone observations.

tools.rea: existing pinned rea-agents package, process-only environment

facts: QMNetwork type-2 constructed adapter vtable first slot calls delayed tp2p.dll!_GetTP2PInterface@0, via RVA 0x3a6dd / delay-IAT 0x25c7b4. This is a static loading edge, not a new runtime load observation.
Both tp2p and TVKDownloadProxy contain tp_dp_file; the shared basename does not identify a unique writer.
tp2p exposes local URL, resource info, preload, cache and external-cache C entry names, plus a singleton C++ interface. ABI and ownership were not reconstructed or exercised.

tp2p contains separate CDN/PCDN/cache byte counter names, concurrent CDN Range/requestOffset diagnostics, and configurable host/vhost plus replacement-host diagnostics. No current counter value or selected host is observed.

TVK exposes a separate GetTPDownloadProxyFactory and parameter vocabulary for size/time preload, priority, cache-first, network, HTTP speed and QUIC. Its actual participation in QQ type-2 playback is unknown.
unknowns: Which module wrote the currently unexplained bytes and whether its input was CDN, peer, cache, another HTTP stack or a combination.
